text:
These are leisure hours from a labor I wrote
in a rough age with an untuned reed;
a device of Love, who condemns to this
the one who hated moderation.


I sang of pain, weeping for joy,
and sometimes sang my grief so sweetly
that everyone thought it belonged to another,
but my soul knows well that it was mine.


If you are not celebrated by everyone,
voices of love, look at my thoughts:
you will see no better fortune awaits you.


Let no discerning soul call you wasted,
for if the wind alone carries you away,
there you will meet my hope.

translation.title: These Are Leisure Hours from a Labor I Wrote
